title: Selling your car to Northwind: how it works
text: Selling your car to Northwind takes four steps. First, get an offer: request one online with your VIN or license plate, or walk into any store for a quote on the spot ([Getting a quote at the store](kb:walk_in_quotes)). Second, book an appraisal appointment. Third, a specialist inspects the car in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer ([What can change your offer](kb:what_changes_offer)). Fourth, sign the paperwork and get paid ([When and how you get paid](kb:getting_paid)). Offers last a limited time ([How long is my offer good for?](kb:offer_validity)). You don't have to buy a car from us to sell one ([Do I have to buy a car to sell one?](kb:selling_without_buying)).

title: Selling your car to Northwind: how it works
text: Selling your car to Northwind takes four steps. First, get an instant offer online with your VIN or license plate. Offers are online only: our stores no longer give walk-in quotes. Second, book an appraisal appointment at a store or, in most states, at your home ([Home pickup service](kb:home_pickup)). Third, a specialist inspects the car in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer ([What can change your offer](kb:what_changes_offer)). Fourth, sign the paperwork and get paid ([When and how you get paid](kb:getting_paid)). Bring everything on the [appointment checklist](kb:appointment_checklist). Offers last a limited time ([How long is my offer good for?](kb:offer_validity)).

title: Getting a quote at the store
text: You can walk into any Northwind store without an appointment and get a quote on the spot. A specialist inspects your car while you wait, usually in 30 to 45 minutes, and gives you a written quote. A walk-in quote is valid for 7 days or 300 miles, the same as an online offer. If you accept, you can finish the sale during the same visit. Bring your photo ID, registration and title, or your payoff information if you still have a loan ([What to bring](kb:appointment_checklist)).

title: How long is my offer good for?
text: Your offer is valid for 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever comes first. The expiration date is on your offer page and in the confirmation email. We honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date. If your offer expires, request a new one at any time; the new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower. Rescheduling an appointment doesn't extend the offer ([Rescheduling or canceling](kb:reschedule_cancel)).

title: How long is my offer good for?
text: Offers are valid for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first. The expiration date is on your offer page and in the confirmation email. Offers issued before February 1, 2026 keep their original terms of 7 days or 300 miles. We honor the offer if your appraisal appointment is on or before the expiration date. If your offer expires, request a new one at any time; the new amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower. Rescheduling doesn't extend the offer ([Rescheduling or canceling](kb:reschedule_cancel)).

title: What can change your offer at the appraisal
text: The appraisal confirms your offer unless we find something your online answers didn't mention. The most common reasons for a lower offer are damage or warning lights you didn't tell us about, a missing key or remote ($150 off for each missing key), aftermarket parts that have to be removed or replaced, and mileage more than 300 miles above what you entered. The specialist shows you the reason for any change before you decide, and you can always say no and keep your car. For modified cars, see [Cars with aftermarket modifications](kb:modified_cars).

title: What can change your offer at the appraisal
text: Before the inspection you sign the damage disclosure, form NW-DMG-1, listing any damage you know about. Damage you list on NW-DMG-1 is already priced into your offer and doesn't lower it again. The offer can go down for damage or warning lights you didn't disclose, a missing key or remote ($250 off for each missing key), aftermarket parts that have to be removed or replaced, and mileage more than 250 miles above what you entered. The specialist shows you the reason for any change, and you can always say no. See also [Cars with aftermarket modifications](kb:modified_cars) and [Flood-damaged cars](kb:flood_damage).

title: What to bring to your appraisal appointment
text: Bring these to your appraisal appointment: a valid photo ID for every owner listed on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer statement, form NW-ODO-1, which you can also fill in at the store. If you still have a loan, bring your payoff letter instead of the title ([Getting a payoff letter](kb:payoff_letter)). If an owner can't come, see [When more than one person owns the car](kb:co_owners). Plan for about an hour.

title: What to bring to your appraisal appointment
text: Bring a valid photo ID for every owner listed on the title. In Aldora, a state mobile ID on your phone is accepted; in every other state, bring the physical card. Also bring the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have one in hand, and the odometer disclosure statement, form NW-ODO-2, which replaced NW-ODO-1 on February 1, 2026. With a loan, bring a payoff letter ([Getting a payoff letter](kb:payoff_letter)) unless your lender is in our [e-payoff network](kb:epayoff_network). With a lease, bring your dealer payoff quote ([Selling a car that you lease](kb:leased_car)). If an owner can't come, see [When more than one person owns the car](kb:co_owners). Plan for about an hour.

title: Rescheduling or canceling an appointment
text: You can reschedule or cancel your appraisal appointment online, or by replying to your confirmation text, up to 2 hours before it starts. Rescheduling keeps your offer only if the new time is on or before the offer's expiration date ([How long is my offer good for?](kb:offer_validity)). Canceling is free. If you miss an appointment without canceling, your offer stays valid until it expires and you can book again.

title: Home pickup service
text: In every state we serve, a Northwind specialist can come to your home or office, inspect the car, and complete the sale on the spot, at no charge. The specialist brings the paperwork and pays you by bank draft. Book home pickup when you schedule your appraisal. Have everything on the [appointment checklist](kb:appointment_checklist) ready, and park the car where it can be inspected in daylight.

title: Home pickup service
text: A Northwind specialist can come to your home or office, inspect the car, and complete the sale on the spot. Home pickup costs $99, which is taken out of your payment, and it isn't available in Dunmore. When you book, you sign the home pickup agreement, form NW-PU-1. The specialist pays you by bank draft or starts a direct deposit ([When and how you get paid](kb:getting_paid)). Have everything on the [appointment checklist](kb:appointment_checklist) ready. Cars that don't run can't use home pickup ([Selling a car that doesn't run](kb:non_running_cars)).

title: Do I have to buy a car to sell one?
text: No. You can sell us your car without buying one from us, and the offer is the same either way. If you also want to buy, you can use the sale as a trade-in on your purchase; see [Trading in vs. selling outright](kb:trade_in_vs_sell) for how sales tax can differ.

title: Protecting yourself from offer scams
text: Northwind never asks you to pay anything to receive or release an offer: no fees, gift cards, wire transfers or cryptocurrency. Real offers come only from northwind-auto.example and the Northwind app. If someone calls, texts or emails claiming to be Northwind and asks for a payment or your bank login, don't respond, and report it through the Help Center. Money from a sale always goes to you or to your lender. The only payment you ever make to us is for [negative equity](kb:negative_equity), and only in person at the appointment.
